subject.title: fix: models status auth, browser local-file nav, codex workspace app-server, tui empty sessions

question: Should Codex app-server workspace-write turns gain network egress by default in this PR, or should network remain denied unless an explicit maintainer-approved opt-in is added?
rationale: The proposed default changes an execution sandbox boundary for existing users, which is a security and upgrade policy choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep default denied
options.body: Keep workspace-write networkAccess false and require a separate explicit opt-in or maintainer-sponsored design for app-server network egress.

options.title: Approve default egress
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally make workspace-write app-server turns network-enabled by default, but should pair that with security review, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split the bundle
options.body: Separate the TUI/browser/auth fixes from the sandbox policy change so narrower repairs can proceed while the security direction is decided.

recommendation.title: Keep default denied
recommendation.body: Keep workspace-write networkAccess false and require a separate explicit opt-in or maintainer-sponsored design for app-server network egress.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server and network-proxy work makes this the strongest routing candidate for the sandbox policy decision.
